name: VRM_POL_SATISFACTION_EVENTS
description: This table contains performance obligation line satisfaction events information for customer contract.

columns.name: POL_SATISFACTION_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Satisfaction measurement event unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line identifier.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_MEASUREMENT_NUM
columns.description: Sequence number for the satisfaction measurement record.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_MEASUREMENT_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the satisfaction is measured. This date will be used as the accounting date for the revenue accounting entry. If the satisfaction measurement event is created using the revenue schedule then the default measurement date will be the last date of the period for which the measurement event is created.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_QUANTITY
columns.description: Specifies the quantity satisfied on the measurement date. Used only when the model is Measure Quantity Satisfied. The default value is the fulfilled quantity of the source document line.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_PERCENT
columns.description: Specifies the percentage satisfied on the measurement date. If the model is Measure Percentage Satisfied then the value for this field will be either manually entered by the user or it will be provided by the source system. If the model is Measure Period Satisfied then the value for this field will be derived from the revenue schedule provided for the performance obligation line.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_PERIOD_PROPORTION
columns.description: If the satisfaction measurement model is Measure Period Satisfied then the value for this field will be derived from the revenue schedule provided for the performance obligation line.

columns.name: DISCARDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this satisfaction measurement event was discarded.

columns.name: DISCARDED_DATE
columns.description: The date on which this satisfaction measurement event was discarded.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document subline unique identifier to which this satisfaction event is related.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID
columns.description: Source document additional subline unique identifier to which this additional satisfaction event is related.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the period satisfied. Used only when the model is Measure Period Satisfied.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the period satisfied. Used only when the model is Measure Period Satisfied.

columns.name: PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this performance obligation line satisfaction event is processed or not. Blank indicates processed. N indicates not processed.

columns.name: PROCESSED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Recognized amount for this satisfaction event.

columns.name: PROCESSED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that processed this row.

columns.name: HOLD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this performance obligation line satisfaction event can be processed. Can be used while processing contingencies.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: User entered comments while performing an action on a satisfaction event.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: The process or user interface from which this row is created..

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether satisfaction event is a primary satisfaction event or additional satisfaction event. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SATIS_EVENT_TYPE

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_TYPE_CODE

columns.name: ASE_PROCESS_FLAG

columns.name: ASE_SPLIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the primary satisfaction event is split based on the additional satisfaction event. Valid values are Y and N.
